text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- Eastern Slavonia: Serbs pillage the region as UNTAES turns a blind eye.
- How to trade with Serbia? Is it at all wise to aim for the market of a 3.2 billion German marks inner debt and with 3,000 companies in the red?

- Croatia osiguranje d.d. heading the list of Croatian insurance companies although initial reports claim that its share of the Croatian market has fallen to 72.56 percent in the first six months of 1996 compared to 77.1 percent it held in the first six months of 1997.
- Matej Jankovic forestry and agriculture minister following the parliament's rejection of vote of no confidence for him says: The hunt for my head continues.
- September saw a 0.3 percent rise in Zagreb retail prices compared to previous month.
- Croatian bishops once again call on the parliament to amend the abortion law adopted in 1978. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
